## Checklist

- [ ] My site name is unique and not already used in `sites/`
- [ ] My name matches my folder exactly (`sites/<name>/` → `<name>.page.dawgsec.com`) and follows `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$`
- [ ] The content is club-appropriate (no phishing, malware, or brand-damaging material)
- [ ] This PR **only** touches files under `sites/<name>/` (one folder per PR)
- [ ] Static files only, within the size limits (≤25 MB, ≤2000 files)
